name: react-native-best-practices
headline: Go SDK for Model Context Protocol
short_description: The go-sdk is the official Go SDK designed for integration with Model Context Protocol servers and clients. Developed in collaboration with Google, it simplifies building applications that use advanced model context capabilities.
author: modelcontextprotocol

sections.overview:
The go-sdk is the official Go SDK for the Model Context Protocol, enabling developers to build applications that integrate with MCP servers and clients. Developed in collaboration with Google, it provides a streamlined approach to implementing advanced model context capabilities in Go applications. The SDK simplifies the process of connecting to MCP infrastructure, reducing boilerplate code and development complexity. It supports both server and client implementations, making it suitable for building distributed systems that leverage model context. The project is actively maintained with regular updates and has established community adoption.
Build applications that utilize model context features for enhanced user interactions.
Integrate Go applications with Model Context Protocol to facilitate communication between services.
Develop client-server architectures using Go to streamline application deployment.
Create APIs for machine learning models that can be easily consumed by other applications.
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
